profile: Actual native application, local Codex generation, real Tavily/cache; not deployment-provider evaluation
method: Two new casual questions are sealed without reading implementation changes after freeze4 is supplied. Root sees neither prompt until both one-shot native captures finish. Independent review checks the returned calculation records and filing excerpts without external searches.

rubric.scale: Each dimension is scored 0, 1, or 2: absent or materially wrong; partially useful; fully supported and useful. Every requested output must be tracked separately.

dimensions.request_coverage: Addresses every requested part; an explicit evidence gap counts as honest handling but not as a substantive answer. Does not mark a silently omitted part complete.
dimensions.useful_synthesis: Answers in plain language, prioritizes material findings, explains their relevance, and distinguishes evidence from interpretation. Avoids a string of source metadata and repeated caveats.
dimensions.provenance: Material factual claims have inspectable supporting citations. Filing facts, calculations, issuer statements, and third-party views remain distinguishable; duplicate views of one source do not imply corroboration.
dimensions.honest_limits: Does not invent dates, completed transactions, causation, or public consensus. Timeframes and partial coverage are stated briefly when material. Unsupported scope is identified without discarding supported parts.

failure_conditions: A requested part is omitted while the response is complete.
A material financial or event claim is unsupported, or an unsupported consensus is invented.
Explicit filings-only instructions trigger live research.
An unsupported price request receives an invented quote or blocks an otherwise answerable filing request.
The response consists primarily of restrictions or search diagnostics despite having usable relevant evidence.
rubric.evaluation_note: Do not require particular current events, exact routes, exact phrasing, a fixed number of sources, or a positive news finding. Judge response quality against evidence actually available. A supported no-finding answer can pass when scope and search coverage are clear.

summary.budget_note: Global shared ledger includes concurrent root activity. These two filings-only cases invoke no live tools and spend no Tavily calls.
summary.latency_note: Actual native wall-clock and answer-token timing includes application scheduling. This is not deployment-provider, Cloud Run or cold-start evidence.

cases.question: from amds filings did operating margin improve from fy24 to fy25? just show the margins and the change then a quick takeaway. no news or long list of underlying numbers
required_outputs: Checked FY2024 and FY2025 operating margins
The margin change with correct units
criteria: Does not require printing every revenue/operating-income ancestor when derived calculation citations provide inspection access
Distinguishes percentage-point change from percent change
Does not produce a false missing-evidence status for registered calculation ancestry
source_checks: Displayed references are C1/C2/C3 only. C1 records FY2024 operating margin 7.368625169672290091138258678%; C2 records FY2025 10.66428014665550391177574410%.

C3 records C2 minus C1 = 3.295654976983213820637485422 percentage points, correctly rounded to +3.30. Subtracting the rounded printed margins would differ; the calculation correctly uses unrounded values.
C1/C2 identify F1-F4 input ancestry; C3 preserves all four source IDs. Every calculation has a registered bundle and inspection URL.
The answer is complete without printing financial-input ancestors and gives the requested brief supported interpretation.
No search or extraction tool is invoked.

cases.question: i keep seeing qct and qtl in qualcomms 2025 report. what are they and how does each make money? use the report only
required_outputs: How the two businesses earn revenue
criteria: Clearly distinguishes semiconductor/platform sales from intellectual-property licensing
Grounds explanations in the selected filing
Honors the report-only instruction without live search
Avoids exposing internal worker handoffs or introducing unnecessary calculation requirements
source_checks: S5 explicitly identifies QCT as Qualcomm CDMA Technologies and QTL as Qualcomm Technology Licensing, and describes semiconductor platforms/software versus IP rights.
S6 supports substantially all QCT revenue being equipment revenue and QTL revenue principally being handset royalties.
S7 supports quarterly per-unit royalties based generally on wholesale complete-product prices, with caps/minimums and some fixed per-unit amounts.
S9 supports the 3G/4G/5G cellular-essential patent explanation.
No search or extraction tool is invoked; the final answer contains no internal worker-handoff commentary.

combined_fresh_validation.scope: The latest two fresh sets span two separately frozen runtime versions: four cases on freeze3 and two additional filings-only cases on freeze4. This is not a six-case evaluation of one unchanged runtime and not a general accuracy estimate.
combined_fresh_validation.earlier_failures: Initial eighteen-case and subsequent six-case failures remain preserved under their own runtime hashes and are not reclassified as unseen passes.
